sec: FLD features, NASH histology, risk-factor table and 2-hit progression

items.q: How is NAFLD defined under 'Features' of Fatty Liver Disease?
opts: Macrovesicular fat / steatosis in ≥ 5% of hepatocytes
items.exp: 'NAFLD : macrovesicular fat / steatosis ≥5% hepatocytes (Non alcoholic FLD)'. The micrograph caption reads 'macrovesicular fat in NAFLD'. (Book p1030)

items.q: NAFLD splits into two groups — match — 1) 80% 2) 20% … A) Fatty liver + inflammation = NASH B) Isolated fatty liver (IFL)
items.exp: 80% Isolated fatty liver (IFL); 20% Fatty liver + Inflammation: NASH (non-alcoholic steatohepatitis). (Book p1030)

items.q: Four histological components branch from NASH. Which is NOT one of them?
items.exp: Branches: Ballooning change; Degree of steatosis; Lobular inflammation; Chicken-wire fibrosis (Zone 3). (Book p1030)

items.q: Fill up: The fibrosis pattern of NASH is '______ fibrosis (Zone ______)'.
Risk-factor table, column 'Common conditions with established association' — which is NOT in that column?
items.exp: Column 1: Obesity, T2DM/insulin resistance, dyslipidemia, metabolic syndrome, PCOS, starvation/rapid weight loss, ↓ adiponectin, leptin resistance. Hypothyroidism is in column 2. (Book p1030)

items.q: Judge from column 1: I Adiponectin levels are printed as decreased. II Leptin is printed as deficient.
items.exp: '↓ Adiponectin levels' and 'Leptin Resistance' (not deficiency). (Book p1030)

items.q: Column 'Other conditions associated with NAFLD' — which is NOT listed?
items.exp: Column 2: Hypothyroidism, OSA, Hypopituitarism, Hypogonadism, Pancreatoduodenal resection, Psoriasis. (Book p1030)

items.q: Match — 1) T2DM / insulin resistance 2) Hypopituitarism 3) Hypogonadism … A) Other conditions associated B) Common established association
items.exp: T2DM/insulin resistance is column 1; hypopituitarism and hypogonadism are column 2. (Book p1030)

items.q: Drugs column — which drug is NOT printed among the six NAFLD-associated drugs?
items.exp: Drugs: L-asparaginase, Bleomycin, Tetracycline, Griseofulvin, Valproate, Amiodarone. (Book p1030)

items.q: Fill up: NASH progression follows a ______-hit hypothesis; the 1st hit is ______.
items.exp: '2 hit hypothesis — Normal liver —1st hit: Risk factors→ NASH —2nd hit: unknown R/F→ Cirrhosis'. (Book p1030)

items.q: What proportion of NASH patients progress to cirrhosis, and over what period?
items.exp: '2nd hit : unknown R/F — 10–15% pts over 15 yrs → Cirrhosis'. (Book p1030)

items.q: In the progression diagram an arrow runs directly from NASH to HCC, bypassing cirrhosis, labelled 'Only in NASH & ______'. Complete it.
items.exp: 'Only in NASH & Hep B virus infection' — HCC without intervening cirrhosis. Cirrhosis itself branches to portal hypertension, liver failure and HCC. (Book p1030)
